biotools.summary: phiXXer is a bioinformatics pipeline facilitating de novo read assembly and vector trimming for high-throughput fosmid sequencing directly from bacterial colonies. It is presented in conjunction with a novel nanopore sequencing approach that eliminates liquid culturing or fosmid purification steps.
